dashboard.map_desc: Real-time geographical distribution of violations. Data is fed directly from the compliance engine.

report.exec_summary_p1: This report provides a comprehensive analysis of packaged commodities compliance across major regions. Over the last 30 days, a total of {{total}} automated inspections were conducted. The data indicates a stable compliance rate, though {{critical}} critical violations were flagged requiring immediate regulatory action.
report.exec_summary_p2: The highest frequency of infractions involves Missing MRP Labels (Rule 6) and Net Quantity Mismatches (Rule 18), particularly concentrated in urban distribution centers.
report.trend_caption: Fig 1: Trend line showing the inverse relationship between compliance rates and total reported violations.
